name: What the owner does with a thinker's element in an encounter

values.gloss: take it whole into the model (the owner, 2026-07-15: incorporate fully and go further)
take it under a concept of ours that says it better
reject it, and say on which axis

note: The encounter is the deep operation around one thinker (the owner, 2026-07-15), as against the foil, which is tactical.
